senses.gloss:
2 अ॑नु m. man, esp. non-Aryan;
 N. of a king.
अनुकच्छम् adv. on the bank (of a river, lake, etc.).
अनुकम्पक a. compassionate towards (—˚).
अनुकम्पन n. ˚कम्पा f. compassion, pity.
अनुकम्पनीय a. pitiable, deplorable.
अनुकम्पार्थम् adv. from pity for (gen.).
अनुकम्पिन् a. = अनुकम्पक.

अनुकर॑ a. doing after, imitating;
 m. assistant, helper.
1 अनुकार m. imitation.
2 अनुकार a. imitating, resembling.
अनुकरण n. imitation.

अनुकल्प m. secondary injunction, subsidiary rule (opp.
प्रथमकल्प).
अनुकाङ्क्षिन् a. striving after (—˚).
1 अनुकाम॑ m. wish, desire.

2 अनुकाम॑ a. corresponding to a wish;
 n. adv.
अनुकारिन् = prec.
अनुकीर्तन n. the mentioning or naming of (—˚).

अनुकूल a. dwelling or lying on the shore;
 favourable
(orig said of the wind blowing along or toward the shore, opp.
प्रतिकूल), convenient, pleasant. n. ˚कू॑लम् adv.
अनुकूलता f. ˚त्व n. favour, inclination.
अनुकूलय् अनुकूल˚यति favour, flatter, conciliate.
अनुकृत* n. अनुकृति f. imitation.

अनुक्त a. unsaid, not spoken of;
 abstr. ˚त्व n.

अनुक्रोश m. compassion, tenderness (p. ˚वन्त्);
˚शात्मता f. compassionate disposition.
अनुक्षणम् adv. every moment, perpetually.

अनुग॑ a. going after, following, corresponding to (—˚). m.
companion, attendant.
अनुगति f. ˚गम m., ˚गमन going after, following.
अनुगर m. request or summons to the reciter ((r.)).
अनुगर्जित n. roaring echo.

अनुगामिन् a. going behind, following. m. servant,
attendant.
अनुगीत n. imitating (lit. after-) song or hum.
अनुगीति f. N. of a metre.
अनुगुप्त a. kept, guarded, hidden.
अनुगृहीत a. favoured, satisfied, happy.
अनुग्रह m. favour, kindness, service, benefit.

अनुचिन्तन n. ˚चिन्ता f. the thinking of (—˚),
recollection.
अनुच्चलन्त् a. not moving from (abl.).

अनुजीविन् a. living upon another, dependent. m. servant,
f. ˚नी.
अनुज्ञा f. ˚न n. leave, permission.
अनुज्ञात a. allowed, permitted, authorized.
अनुतट adv. on the edge or shore.
अनुतटम् adv. on the edge or shore.
अनुताप m. repentance, woe, sorrow.
अनुत्खात n. not uneven, i.e. level, ground.
अ॑नुत्त a. unshaken, invincible.

अनुत्तम a. highest (lit. not having a highest), supreme,
best, most, excellent.
अनुत्पत्ति f. ˚त्पाद m. non-arising.
अनुत्पाद्य ger. without having begotten (sons).

अनुत्सुक a. unpresumptuous, modest;
 abstr. ˚ता f.

अनुत्सेक m. non-haughtiness, modesty;
 poss. ˚किन्.
अनुदक॑ a. waterless.
अनुदय m. not coming forth.
अनुदर्श m. admonition, exhortation.
अनुदर्शन n. regard, consideration.
अनुदासीन a. not indifferent.
अ॑नुदित a. unspoken or not risen.
अनुदिन (˚—) & अनुदिनम् adv. daily.
अनुदिवसम् adv. the same.
अनुद्घात m. no jolt or jerk.
अनुद्घाय्य ger. without opening.

अ॑नुद्धत a. not haughty;
 m. a low place.
अ॑नुद्धृत a. not taken out, not deducted.
अनुद्विग्न a. not perplexed or frightened.
अनुद्वेग m. freedom from anguish, tranquillity, ease.
अनुद्वेगकर a. not causing fright.
अनुद्वेजयन्त् a. not frightening.
अनुधावन n. running after, pursuit.

अनुनय m. conciliatory behaviour, friendliness,
prepossession.
अनुनासिक a. nasal (g.).
अनुपकारिन् a. not assisting.
अनुपक्रम्य a. incurable.
अनुप˚क्राम्य a. incurable.
अनुपघ्नन्त् a. not damaging or impairing.
अ॑नुपथ a. walking along the path.
अनुपदेष्टव्य a. not to be commended.
अनुपपत्ति f. not taking place, failing, impossibility.
अनुपपन्न a. unsuitable, improper. unworthy of (loc.).
अनुपभोग्य a. unfit to be eaten or drunk.
अनुपम a. incomparable, excellent.
अनुपयन्त् a. not approaching (a wife).
अनुपयुक्त a. useless, unapplicable, unsuitable.
अनुपलब्धि f. ˚लम्भ m. non-perception.
अनुपसर्ग a. not compounded with a preposition.

अनुपस्कृत a. unprepared, unfinished;
 simple, plain.
अनुपहित a. unconnected, independent, absolute.
अनुपाकृत a. not consecrated.
अनुपालिन् a. preserving, guarding.

अनुपूर्व a. following in one's turn, successive, orderly,
regular. ˚—, अनुपूर्व॑म् & अनुपू˚र्वशस् in due order, successively,
further.

आनुपूर्व n. ˚पूर्वी f., ˚पूर्व्य n. order, succession;
instr. in due order, one after the other.
अनुपृक्त a. mixed with (—˚).
अ॑नुपेत a. not yet having gone (to the teacher).
अनुपेतपूर्व the same.
अनुपेय a. not to be married.
अनुप्रमाण a. proportionate, adequate.

अनुप्रविष्ट a. fled to (acc.), entered (act. & pass.);
hidden, concealed.
अनुप्रवेश m. entry, entering.
अनुप्रास m. alliteration.
अनुबद्ध a. bound, fettered, connected, coherent.
अनुभर्तृ॑ a. supporting or refreshing.
अनुभव m. apprehension, perception.
अनुभाव m. power, dignity.
अनुभाग m. subdivision.
अनुभाविन् a. perceiving, knowing.

अ॑नुमति f. = prec.;
 N. of a moon-goddess.
अनुमन्तृ॑ a. consenting, permitting.

अनुमरण n. the dying after, esp. the self-cremation of
a widow after her husband's death.
अनुमा॑द्य a. to be hailed or greeted with acclamation.
अनुमान m. inference (ph.).
अनुमालिनीतीरम् adv. on the bank of the Māliṇī.

अनुमित a. thought, conceived, inferred, conjectured from
(abl.).
अनुयाज॑ m. after-offering ((r.)).

अनुयात्र n. ˚त्रा f., ˚त्रिक m. pl. retinue,
attendance.

अनुयायिन् a. going after, following;
 pl. = prec.
अनुयुगम् adv. according to the (four) ages.
अनुयोग m. question, censure.
अनुरत a. fond of (loc. or —˚), enamoured.

अनुरसित a. cried after;
 n. echo.

अनुराग m. colouring, redness, affection (poss. ˚वन्त्);
red, affectionate, enamoured (सह or loc.).
अनुरागिन् a. loving or lovely.
अनुलग्न a. following immediately (—˚).
अनुलेप m. ˚न n. unction, unguent, roughcast.

अनुलोम॑ a. with the hair or grain, i.e. natural, regular.
अनुलोम (˚—) ˚म॑म् adv. f. अनुलोमा a woman of a caste inferior to
the man's;
 ˚मज m. her son.

अनुल्बण॑ a. not excessive;
 moderate, correct.
अनुव॑चन m. speaking after, repeating, reciting.
अनुवर्तन n. = अनुवृत्ति.

अनुवर्तिन् a. following (acc. or —˚);
 obedient.

अनुवश a. obedient;
 m. obedience.

अनुवाक॑ m. recital, reading;
 section, chapter.
अनुवाद m. repetition, explanation.

अनुवादिन् n. repeating, answering or corresponding to
(—˚).
अ॑नुवित्त a. found, existing.

अनुविधायिन् a. obedient;
 conformable (—˚).
अनुवेलम् adv. hour by hour, continually.
अनुव्य᳙म् adv. behind, below.
अनुव्याख्या॑न n. a cert. class of texts.
अनुव्रज्या f. following (a departed guest).

अनुशय m. repentance, regret, rescission of sale or
purchase (j).
अनुशासन n. instruction, precept, command.
अनुशासनीय a. to be instructed.
अनुशासितृ m. ruler, commander.
अनुशासिन् a. reprimanding, punishing (—˚).
अनुशास्ति f. instruction.

अ॑नुशिष्ट a. taught, bidden, commanded (pers. & th.),
inflicted, executed, punished.

अनुषङ्ग m. connexion, association, necessary
consequence.
अनुषङ्गिन् a. attached, connected.
अ॑नुष्टुति f. praise, eulogy.
अनुष्ट्र a. except camels.
अनुष्ठान n. performing, practice.

अ॑नुष्ठित a. following, imitating, practising (acc.);
accompanied, assisted, practised, effected, done, begun.
अनुष्ठु॑ adv. directly, forthwith.
अनु˚ष्ठुया॑ adv. directly, forthwith.
अनु˚ष्ठ्या॑ adv. directly, forthwith.
अनुष्ठेय a. to be done or accomplished.
अनुष्वध॑म् adv. willingly, freely.
अनुसंस्थित a. followed or died after (acc.).
अनुसंचर m. follower.
अनुसंधान n. inquiry, investigation.
अनुसंध्यम् adv. about dusk.*

अनुसर f. ई going after;
 m. attendant.
अनुसरण n. following, pursuing.

अनुसारिन् a. following, striving after, according with,
seeking for (acc. or —˚).
अनुसृत्य ger. following, i.e. according to (acc.).
अनुसेवा f. attendance, service.

अ॑नुस्पष्ट a. seen^1, observed.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.

अनुस्यूत interwoven with (—˚);
 abstr. ˚त्व n.

अनुस्वार m. the nasal element of a nasalized vowel and
its sign (g.).
अ॑नूक m. n. the spine.
अनूक्ति f. repeated mention, study.
अनूचान॑ a. learned, esp. in the Veda.
अनूचीन॑ a. following each other, successive.
अनूढा f. unmarried (of a woman).
अनूनवस्तुक a. of perfect substance or nature.
आनुयात्रिक (±जन) m. follower, attendant.
आनुवेश्य m. the next neighbour but one.
आनुलोम्य n. natural order (cf. अनुलोम).
आनुष॑क् adv. coherently, uninterruptedly.
आनुषङ्गिक a. connected, adherent.
